mapper.select: WITH source AS ( SELECT c.course_id, c.rev_no, c.geom, COALESCE( ST_SRID(c.geom) = 5179 AND GeometryType(c.geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_NDims(c.geom) = 2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(c.geom) AND ST_IsValid(c.geom), false ) AS geometry_valid FROM public.course c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND c.del_yn = 'N' ) SELECT course_id, rev_no, CASE WHEN geometry_valid THEN encode(ST_AsEWKB(geom), 'hex') END AS geometry_hex, CASE WHEN geometry_valid THEN ST_Length(geom) END AS actual_length_m, geometry_valid FROM source
